name: Fujibayashi Hotaru
source:
A ninja who completes her missions with full effort.
She was born into the Fujibayashi clan, one of the three influential branches of the Iga ninja.
When she was young both her parents died, and she was raised by and polished her skills under her teacher's guidance.
She is serious and a very disciplined kuniochi.
Upon receiving a request from a certain person she infiltrated Azuchi Castle.
